The synthetic refine and the DeepCenter veto need frames, which the lab does not have ('unknown = accept'). So the one knob that matters for the node multiplier, the synthetic cap, would be tuned on unrefined, unvetoed points. (3) The mechanism is partly idle and the headroom is overstated. In the g=0 LAP column the relink already forces every pair inside its gate, and 'relink leaves 0 end->start pairs within 5 um' (CONTEXT L254). So the new part reduces to g=1..3, which gap1, gap2 and gapfill already cover greedily. The upper bound double counts. The 424 free-end FN are a subset of the 2,929 detection-side FN, which include a_tail 606 (fn_anatomy_exp39.md L9-10, L56). Only ~115 of the 606 a_tail FN are attachable to a free end or start, and there are only 58 one-frame gap bridges (l6_fn_anatomy_report.md L115-116). The LB already said 'gap closing saturated' (A20 GAP_CLOSE 6.5 = -0.001). The realistic lab signal is about +0.0005..+0.0015, below the +0.002 gate.
